Data Deletion Policy
Effective Date: May 18, 2026 · Last Updated: May 18, 2026
How to Request Deletion of Your Data
You have the right to request that VAYDIN PARTNERS INVESTMENTS - FZCO ("Vaydin") delete personal data we hold about you.
To submit a request:
Send an email to hello@vaydin.agency
Use the subject line: Data Deletion Request
Include the contact details (such as phone number or email address) associated with your data so that we can locate it
We may follow up to verify your identity before proceeding, to protect your data from unauthorised deletion requests.
What We Will Delete
Upon a valid request, we will delete the personal data we hold about you, including:
Communication and message history
Any business information you have provided to us
What We May Retain
We may retain certain limited information where we are required or permitted to do so by law, including:
Financial, tax, or accounting records, for the period required by applicable law
Information necessary to resolve disputes, enforce agreements, or comply with legal or regulatory obligations
Aggregated or anonymised data that no longer identifies you
Any retained information will be handled in accordance with our Privacy Policy and applicable law.
We will complete your deletion request within thirty (30) days of confirming your identity, unless a longer period is required or permitted by applicable law.
In such cases, we will inform you of the expected timeframe.
Once deletion is complete, we will send a confirmation email to the address from which the request was made.
If you have questions about this Data Deletion Policy, your rights, or how we handle personal data:
Dubai Silicon Oasis Free Zone
Email: hello@vaydin.agency
For our full data handling practices, please see our Privacy Policy.

ILLUSTRATION · THE SHOP IN MOTION
THE MYSTERY SHOP · THREE DOORS
Your patients test you every day.
Now someone reports the results.
Every new patient walks through one of three doors and forms a verdict long before anyone greets them.
We walk through all three, the same way, unannounced.
Every 30 to 60 days, on a day nobody in the clinic can predict.
We write to your clinic as a patient, on WhatsApp, because that's where Dubai books.
We ask what real patients ask: the treatment, the price, the availability.
Then we record what your clinic said, and when.
Before messaging, a patient has already seen your Google profile, your rating, your latest reviews, your Instagram.
We review what they see: the verdict formed before you ever knew they existed.
The follow-through
Most clinics answer once.
The real test is what happens after: was a booking offered, did anyone follow up, what happened when we went quiet.
That's where revenue leaks, silently.
